name: User details show the stored email, role, permission sets, manager and reportees
description:
Objective: User details show the stored email, role, permission sets, manager and reportees.
Preconditions: Open User Management with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User Management.
2. User details show the stored email, role, permission sets, manager and reportees.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The expected message or notification is delivered once with the relevant details.
